experiment: Physarum polycephalum bounded-sample acquisition route v0.1

source.title: A mathematical model to predict network growth in Physarum polycephalum as a function of extracellular matrix viscosity, measured by a novel viscometer
selectedArchiveContents: FractalDimension/*/FractalDimension.csv: timestep, fractal dimension, slope, R2, intercept, StdError
Growth/*/growthResults.csv: time in minutes, network area in mm2
source.reasonForSelection: This is a small, public, relation-to-time bearing specimen that can test temporal structure without downloading the much larger microscopy collections first.

alternateSource.title: Raw datasets and R scripts for polyxenic cultivation of Didymium and Physarum species: germination, purification, growth dynamics, sclerotia viability, and sporocarp production
alternateSource.recordEvidence: Zenodo public record explicitly lists six Excel datasets plus R scripts and identifies plasmodial growth models as a supported analysis target.
alternateSource.reasonForSelection: The file is small, directly relevant to growth dynamics, versioned by DOI, and suitable as a bounded unfamiliar specimen without importing the larger image stacks first.
alternateSource.byteFetchState: The web retrieval layer could resolve the binary download target but could not decode the XLSX as text; the execution container has no outbound DNS, so bytes were not independently materialized in this run. No specimen ingestion or hash conversion is claimed beyond the MD5 published by Zenodo.

provenance.dryadDownloadAttemptState: Official Dryad file_stream endpoint returned HTTP 403 in prior retrieval attempts. No archive bytes were obtained.
provenance.zenodoRouteState: Open public record and exact bounded file are verified; actual local byte materialization remains pending because the available execution environment cannot fetch the binary directly.
provenance.identityRule: Before organ ingestion record exact download URL, retrieval timestamp, byte size, archive/member list when applicable, and SHA-256 of the retrieved specimen. Published repository checksums may be retained as upstream identity evidence but do not replace local SHA-256.

publicStructureEvidence.dryadFractalDimension: FractalDimension.csv rows are time-indexed every 60 seconds and include fractal dimension, slope, R2, intercept, and standard error.
publicStructureEvidence.dryadGrowth: growthResults.csv contains time in minutes and network area in mm2.
publicStructureEvidence.zenodoGrowth: Zenodo describes the selected workbook as plasmodial growth by feed area and pairs the dataset collection with reproducible R analysis scripts.
publicStructureEvidence.useBoundary: Public record fields may guide routing and test design only; they are not substituted for missing specimen bytes.

blindIngestionInstruction: Treat any retrieved bounded specimen as unfamiliar external material. Do not provide an analogy or target lesson.
candidateQuestionsForbiddenAtIngestion: Do not tell the organs to learn adaptation, decentralization, memory, routing, or self-organization.
Do not preclassify temporal change as a ZENOMORPH architectural lesson.
Do not equate growth dynamics, fractal dimension, area, or slime-mold morphology with any named organ.

gates.A_provenance: FAIL until actual specimen bytes are retrieved and locally hashed

crossFoodCounterexample.urban: A street edge is a contemporaneous topological relation; a Physarum growth row is a time-indexed measurement and must not be promoted to an edge merely because both describe networks.
crossFoodCounterexample.maleCNS: A SWC parent-child relation is explicit morphology topology; a Physarum time series may describe changing geometry without encoding pairwise edges.
crossFoodCounterexample.hca: Sample-donor membership is typed membership; Physarum measurements add a temporal dimension that must remain distinct from both membership and topology.

fallbackRoute.primary: Retry official Dryad bytes through a supported public API or official mirror.
fallbackRoute.secondary: Use the verified Zenodo bounded growth workbook once binary retrieval is available; preserve DOI, exact file name, published MD5, local SHA-256, and retrieval timestamp.
fallbackRoute.tertiary: If both remain byte-blocked, advance another public unfamiliar-food source rather than fabricating a specimen from metadata.
fallbackRoute.forbidden: Do not create pseudo-rows, synthetic values, or inferred temporal edges from README/abstract text.

nextGate: Materialize either official Physarum bounded specimen, hash locally, extract a deterministic subset, then run relation-type plus time-validity classification before five-organ metabolism.
